about: How Dot's data was mapped. keyDisposition lists every Dot fact key that has no slot (count of variants carrying it).

naming.rule: Trims lose the advertisement or sheet text they were read from, a repeat of the model name, and a model year that the model_year field already holds; a trim that was only the model name becomes 'Base' plus the drive. Model names keep the maker's Australian styling (BYD ATTO / DOLPHIN / SEAL, Hyundai IONIQ / KONA, Cadillac LYRIQ, smart #1); the original 34 keep their own spelling (e.g. Sealion 7). Only 'GLC electric' was respelled. Trims that are still identical for the same brand and model get '(MYnn)' from their model year. Ids and slugs are built from Dot's raw trim and do not change.

priceLabelled.rule: Prices on announced (not yet on sale) versions and on outgoing versions with no order confirmation say 'Announced' or 'Last listed' in their basis and carry a qualification.

offersWithEndDate.rule: Rows with a validUntil date store it as valid_until; src/lib/verification.ts isExpiredOffer hides them from that date.
